name: Jungle Bank
tagline: A mobile banking simulator for people in wild environments, running on a real phone.

awards: Desjardins - Sponsor Challenge // Desjardins - Défi commandité

problem: The sponsor challenge asked for a banking app for an adventurous setting.
solution: A React Native app with a Python backend simulating banking actions.
demo_moment: Team-described: the app working on a physical device.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Desjardins - Sponsor Challenge // Desjardins - Défi commandité” among 260 submissions.
Got the app running on a physical device.

lessons: A working device demo can carry a minimal feature set.
